technical-specificity-faster.title: Technical specificity regarding business inputs and goals predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, concrete objectives, or economic and environmental rationales accelerate funding regardless of gender.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

female-nwtf-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a history of successful loans from NWTF fund faster.
female-nwtf-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference previous successful loan cycles with NWTF are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

female-children-count-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify the number of children or dependents fund faster.
female-children-count-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the number of children or dependents they support are associated with increased funding speed.

female-financial-motivation-faster.body: Female borrowers who explain the specific financial motivation for a purchase fund faster.

male-child-academic-success-faster.body: Male borrowers who mention specific academic successes of their children fund faster.

male-community-impact-faster.body: Male borrowers who emphasize community impact may fund faster.

female-family-employment-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention the employment or professional status of a spouse or child fund faster.

pleading-slower-general.body: Explicitly asking lenders for help or pleading for funding predicts slower funding regardless of gender.

male-customer-loyalty-faster.body: Male borrowers who mention a loyal customer base fund faster.

female-local-currency-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who express explicit gratitude to lenders may fund more slowly.

male-institutional-training-faster.body: Male borrowers who mention specific institutional affiliations or training programs fund faster.

female-abstract-goals-slower.body: Female borrowers who use abstract language like 'dreams' to describe goals fund more slowly.

female-gratitude-slower.title: Female borrowers who express direct gratitude to lenders may fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-slower.retrospective: FIFO drop to make room for new retired items.

female-local-currency-slower-puzzle.title: Female borrowers who mention the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.

female-age-mention-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age in the pitch may fund more slowly.

female-community-volunteering-slower.title: Female borrowers who detail specific community volunteering commitments may fund more slowly.
female-community-volunteering-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observation.

female-local-currency-slower.title: Pitches from women that specify the loan amount using local currency denominations, such as PHP, are associated with slower funding speeds.
female-local-currency-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted education-business link claim.

female-education-goals-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific educational goals or school status for children may fund more slowly.
female-education-goals-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that linking children/schooling to business help predicts faster funding.

male-family-partnership-faster.title: Male borrowers who emphasize family partnership and specify child ages may fund faster.
male-family-partnership-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-education-business-link-faster.title: Pitches from women that connect the need for funding to both the support of children's education and the growth of business income accelerate funding.
female-education-business-link-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted logistical-details-slower-general claim.

female-gratitude-faster.title: Female borrowers who express direct gratitude to lenders may fund faster.
female-gratitude-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that slower female pitches include explicit gratitude markers.

logistical-details-slower-general.title: Including logistical minutiae such as operating hours or travel distance predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
logistical-details-slower-general.retrospective: Retired to make room for promoted female-children-count-faster claim.
